sheet_name: IRDAI (Insurance Brokers) Regulations, 2018 — Direct, Reinsurance and Composite Broker registration and conduct
// sheet_name: Deliberately longer than the gazette title. Detection breaks near-ties on distinctive title words found in the document, and 'brokers' alone (capped at 12 occurrences) lost to frb_regulations_2024, whose 'foreign' and 'branches' are incidentally frequent in a brokers document. The added words — direct, reinsurance, composite — are the three broker categories regulation 3 actually creates, so the title stays accurate.
// hindi: Unlike most gazettes in this set, this PDF carries no Hindi half at all — the English notification starts on page 1.
ignore_patterns: INSURANCE REGULATORY AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA
// no containers: Only two CHAPTER lines exist in 100 pages and regulation 1 precedes CHAPTER I, so containers would mis-nest; PART A/B/C are subdivisions inside chapter II. Segmented flat, as reinsurance_regulations_2018 is.
// section: Regulation heads run x0 68-81; the (1)/(2) sub-regulations sit at 89.4/90.0 and the schedule/form items at 90.0, so max_x0 82 admits the regulations and excludes both. The space after the number is OPTIONAL here: regulations 1-9 are typeset '9. Payment' but 10 onwards as '10.Procedure', and requiring \s silently dropped 30 of the 59 regulations into their predecessors. The letter lookahead keeps '3.1'-style sub-items and decimals like '12.5%' from matching, since a digit follows their period.
// form_starts: Pages 36-100 are Schedule I Forms A-Q, Schedule II Forms R-Z and Schedule AA — application forms whose items restart at '1.' and would otherwise be segmented as regulations, colliding with the real ones.
